4d3143ccab0e.title: Incomplete Shell Command Parsing
4d3143ccab0e.reason: Redirections are caught whatever the command (echo "x" > f, printf ... >> f, cat > f, 2> f), and tee, sed/perl -i, cp/mv/install, rm/truncate/touch and dd of= are handled; shell_writes_finds_what_a_command_changes covers each. It is a guard against a model working around the protection, not a shell parser (documented on the function); the runner's grants still limit where a command may write.
